# Composure 90-Day Execution Plan (Locked Version)

**Start Date: February 12**  
**Thailand Move-In: February 18**  
**Work Begins: February 19**

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# PART 1: BEFORE THAILAND (Feb 12 - Feb 17)

## Objective

Prepare foundation so Thailand = execution, not preparation.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## DAY 1 - Lock Positioning + Landing Page

### Positioning (Do Once, Do Not Edit)

Composure helps competitive tennis players stop losing tight matches because of mental mistakes.

### Build Simple Landing Page

Include:
- Clear headline (above)
- 3 problems:
  - Forget what went wrong after matches
  - Do not know what to fix between lessons
  - Train hard but still lose tight sets
- 3 screenshots
- Short demo clip (or screenshot sequence if no clip yet)
- Reddit proof quotes
- Email capture (`Join Early Access`)

No redesigning. Functional only.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## DAY 2 - Write 10 Hooks

Examples:
- Your backhand is not bad. You are just late.
- Why you always lose at 4-4.
- Stop focusing on fancy takebacks.
- You do not lose because of technique.
- You are not bad. You are tight.

Write only. Do not film yet.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## DAY 3-7 - Warm Instagram Account + Format Research

### Daily Algorithm Warm-Up

- Like tennis content
- Comment on 5-10 posts
- Follow competitive players
- Save strong reels

### Daily Format Research

Save 5-10 reels that:
- Have strong hooks
- Have high comments
- Are simple

Study:
- Hook style
- Pacing
- Length
- Delivery

Copy format structure, not words.

No posting yet.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## DAY 5 - Prepare Beta Testers

Message:
- Nick
- 3-5 serious players

Tell them this is beta and you want honest feedback after 2-3 matches.

Create a Google Doc to log feedback.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## DAY 6-7 - App Polish Pass

Fix:
- Obvious UI friction
- Onboarding clarity
- Log Match visibility
- Remove confusion

No redesigns. Only simplify.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# PART 2: THAILAND - 3 MONTH EXECUTION PLAN

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# MONTH 1 (Feb 19 - March 19)

## Goal: Signal + Stability

### Daily Non-Negotiable Rules

1. Post 1 reel per day
2. Improve 1 small thing in app
3. Reply to comments and DMs
4. Log installs and DM replies

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Content Rotation (Repeat Weekly)

Mon - Direct Diagnosis  
Tue - Scenario Breakdown  
Wed - App Demo  
Thu - Direct Diagnosis  
Fri - Scenario Breakdown  
Sat - App Demo  
Sun - Simple rally clip + voiceover

Keep videos 30-45 seconds. One clear idea per video.
End with one CTA: `Become Founder`.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Beta Testing Continues

- 10-20 testers max
- Weekly feedback review
- Fix friction only

Target by March 19:
- 30-60 paying users (if payments enabled)
- At least 1 format performing consistently

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# MONTH 2 (March 19 - April 19)

## Goal: 80-120 Paying Users

- Turn on Founder pricing (`£4.99/mo` or `£59.99/year` annual option)
- Mention `Founder spots available`
- Double down on winning format
- Add testimonials to landing page and content
- Post Reddit update
- Start blog cadence: 1 post/week (SEO starts here)

Continue daily posting.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# MONTH 3 (April 19 - May 19)

## Goal: 120-200 Paying Users

ONLY scale if:
- Payments consistent
- Retention stable
- Format proven

Then:
- 2 posts per day
- Cross-post to TikTok
- Consider second account

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# What You Do NOT Do

- No strategy rewrites
- No multiple accounts early
- No chasing virality
- No emotional reactions to views
- No perfection delays

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Core Focus

Build a machine that produces 3-5 paying users per day consistently.

Consistency > Motivation. Iteration > Emotion. Execution > Perfection.
